"Everything became clear when his wife gave birth to their daughter, because her skin was brown.
The man forgave his wife, accepted his daughter, and vowed to live together as a family of three.
But soon his wife left, abandoning her husband and daughter.
The man swore in his heart to love his daughter even more deeply.
Yet the daughter yearned for a deeper bond with her father..."
